ratification_lineage.instruction: Owner's conditional authorization in the Cursor chat on 2026-11-03: "ODR-004, ODR-005 ผมอนุมัติ ถ้ามันถูกต้องแล้ว", effective for ODR-004 only after the market-data security tests pass and with scope_providers kept empty; not an approval of any specific provider, credentials, paid subscriptions, trading or ODR-005

scope_providers.evidence: OWNER_TERMS_ACCEPTED_AND_DOCUMENTED_PLAN_SCOPE; personal, local, noncommercial use. Alpaca Basic includes the IEX real-time feed and the documented historical SIP access older than 15 minutes; single-venue IEX only. Personal noncommercial display and valuation are supported by the accepted terms. Cache and retention are NOT attested: the terms do not grant blanket storage or redistribution, so observations stay in memory only. Sources: docs.alpaca.markets about-market-data-api / market-data-faq, files.alpaca.markets TermsAndConditions.pdf

OWNER_TERMS_ACCEPTED_AND_DOCUMENTED_PLAN_SCOPE; personal, local, noncommercial use. Historical SIP bars are documented as available to Basic accounts only with the access delay the adapter enforces (15 min + 2 min margin); not real-time and not a consolidated live quote. Cache and retention are NOT attested. Sources as above.

OWNER_TERMS_ACCEPTED_AND_DOCUMENTED_PLAN_SCOPE; personal, local, noncommercial use. Free Forever terms (2026-10-26) permit a personal localhost dashboard and storage on a device the Owner controls while the account is open, with deletion on closure; no additional provider-side derived-data restriction, while exchange agreements still govern. Data is at least 24 h delayed and is labelled HISTORICAL_DELAYED_LAST, never real-time or an official EOD close. Sources: marketdata.app/terms, docs/account/free-accounts, docs/account/entitlements, docs/account/data-freshness
scope_providers.retention_condition: retain while the account is open; delete on account closure

scope_providers.evidence: OWNER_TERMS_ACCEPTED_AND_DOCUMENTED_PLAN_SCOPE; personal, local, noncommercial use. Keyless published ECB reference rates; no account or entitlement step.
